summary: Eureka Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting a one-month extension of its initial business combination deadline from July 3, 2026, to August 3, 2026, via a $8,253.03 deposit into the trust account. The deposit was funded by Marine Thinking Inc. under a prior business combination agreement, and the company issued a non-interest-bearing unsecured promissory note to Marine Thinking for that amount. The extension is a routine SPAC timeline mechanism. The trust account supports public shareholders. Watch for completion or further extensions to avoid liquidation; risk-arb spread hinges on deal consummation within the extended window.
